amendmentPolicy: A release control changes only through an explicit project-owner decision with a durable evidence reference. Environment variables cannot override this register.

evidenceCatalog.locator: deliverables/Sufeiya学生智能诊断与伴学平台方案_讨论稿_2026-08-09.docx

controls.title: Gate A 本机合成学习闭环
controls.scope: Browser-local synthetic demonstration only; no server student data, official score, real community, or formal diagnosis.
controls.implementationImpact: Allows the current browser-local synthetic learning loop while preserving all Gate A limitations.
conditions: Learning evidence remains browser-local and not account-bound.
All diagnostic and progress claims retain Gate A limitations.

controls.title: Clerk 学习页面访问边界
controls.scope: Clerk protects learner and account routes without uploading or binding browser-local learning records.
controls.implementationImpact: Keeps canonical learner routes authenticated while leaving local learning namespaces unbound to the account.
conditions: Authentication is not a teacher, staff, age, or data-processing authorization.
Missing or invalid Clerk configuration fails closed.

controls.title: Sofia 外部文本模型供应商选择
controls.scope: Alibaba Cloud DashScope/Qwen may be configured, but this control alone never permits network processing or release.
controls.implementationImpact: Constrains any future approved external text runtime to the recorded DashScope and Qwen allowlist.
conditions: Only repository-allowlisted models and fixed regional endpoints may be configured.
The exact qwen3.8-max model was verified in the official pay-as-you-go DashScope and OpenAI-compatible backend API documentation on 2026-08-11.
The separate qwen3.8-max-preview Token Plan model and sk-sp credentials remain excluded from the application backend.
Every other Sofia external-text-model control must also be approved.

controls.title: Sofia 外部文本模型数据流
controls.scope: Fields, purposes, recipients, logging, and minimization for questions and learning summaries sent to an external model.
controls.implementationImpact: Keeps all external model calls disabled until a reviewed data mode is recorded and context-bound.

controls.title: Sofia 外部文本模型留存与删除
controls.scope: Supplier retention, training-use settings, deletion procedure, and evidence of deletion behavior.
controls.implementationImpact: Blocks external text-model release until retention and deletion behavior are documented and approved.

controls.title: 外部供应商地域与跨境路径
controls.scope: Selected region, data residency, cross-border path, and deployment-mode implications for external AI services.
controls.implementationImpact: Prevents a configured provider region from becoming an approved processing region by environment variable alone.

controls.title: Sofia 外部文本模型滥用与预算控制
controls.scope: Persistent abuse controls, budget caps, incident handling, and provider outage behavior beyond in-memory rate limiting.
controls.implementationImpact: Retains deterministic fallback and blocks paid external generation until persistent controls are approved.

controls.title: Sofia 主张与引用语义校验
controls.scope: Reviewed evidence that every released answer claim is semantically supported by its displayed source, not merely allowlisted by ID.
controls.implementationImpact: Keeps external generation off while the existing exact-ID allowlist remains a non-semantic safety layer only.

controls.title: Sofia 声音授权声明已收到
controls.scope: Records only that the project owner asserted that the depicted speaker authorized future voice cloning; it is not authorization-document verification.
controls.implementationImpact: Preserves the user assertion without converting it into production voice-release evidence.
conditions: This record does not satisfy written-authorization verification.
It does not approve data flow, retention, disclosure, transport, microphone input, or release.

controls.title: Sofia 书面声音授权证据核验
controls.scope: Verification of the written authorization artifact, covered uses, revocation terms, duration, and identity of the rights holder.
controls.implementationImpact: Prevents the received assertion from being treated as verified release evidence.

controls.title: Sofia 语音供应商与模型选择
controls.scope: Qwen qwen3-tts-vc-realtime-2026-01-15 is the requested future voice-cloning model; configuration alone does not permit release.
controls.implementationImpact: Pins any future approved voice output to DashScope and the exact requested model.
conditions: Every other Sofia voice-output control must also be approved.
Transport remains disabled until independently implemented and reviewed.

controls.title: Sofia 声音复刻数据流
controls.scope: Source audio, generated audio, voice profile, recipients, purpose limitation, and regional processing path.
controls.implementationImpact: Blocks all voice output and microphone processing until exact reviewed data modes are bound.

controls.title: Sofia 声音数据留存与删除
controls.scope: Voice profile and audio retention, revocation, deletion procedure, and evidence of completion.
controls.implementationImpact: Keeps voice transport disabled until deletion and revocation can be exercised and evidenced.

controls.title: Sofia AI 合成声音披露
controls.scope: Learner-visible AI voice labeling, consent/notice timing, and accessibility-equivalent text path.
controls.implementationImpact: Retains the current text-only AI disclosure but does not approve synthesized audio disclosure.

controls.title: Sofia 语音传输实现与安全复核
controls.scope: Implemented transport, authentication, origin controls, timeouts, quotas, logging minimization, and failure fallback.
controls.implementationImpact: Keeps TRANSPORT_IMPLEMENTED false and makes voice activation impossible.

controls.title: 学习者麦克风输入
controls.scope: Microphone permission, capture, ASR processing, retention, deletion, and non-audio alternative.
controls.implementationImpact: Continues to prohibit microphone permission and audio capture in Gate A.

controls.title: 服务器端学生数据处理
controls.scope: Any upload, account binding, cross-device sync, remote research collection, or server-side learner evidence store.
controls.implementationImpact: Keeps learning evidence browser-local and prevents silent account binding or remote collection.

controls.title: 成人邀请制真实社区
controls.scope: Real membership, invitations, experience-card publication, or learner-to-learner interaction.
controls.implementationImpact: Keeps the current community surface synthetic with realCommunityUsed=false.

controls.title: 社区审核与升级机制
controls.scope: Moderation roles, reporting, blocking, escalation matrix, response expectations, evidence-card withdrawal, and shutdown drills.
controls.implementationImpact: Prevents a synthetic card from being promoted into a real community without moderation controls.

controls.title: 真实人工案例队列
controls.scope: Sending learner requests or evidence to a staffed remote queue, including delivery and response expectations.
controls.implementationImpact: Keeps current support requests local_not_sent and blocks any delivery claim.

controls.title: 教研与运营角色授权
controls.scope: Server-verified staff roles, resource-level authorization, reviewer qualification, revocation, and access review.
controls.implementationImpact: Prevents an ordinary Clerk login or local demo identity from being treated as an authorized reviewer.

controls.title: 教研与管理员写入操作
controls.scope: Remote evidence review, recommendation revision, escalation, case resolution, or human-review receipt issuance.
controls.implementationImpact: Prevents local self-attestation from closing a qualified-human-review branch or mutating canonical evidence.

controls.title: 真实奖励或价值转移
controls.scope: Cash, gifts, credits with real value, payment rails, or binding incentive accounting.
controls.implementationImpact: Keeps all incentives simulated and prevents real value transfer.

controls.title: 严重故障停机与恢复演练
controls.scope: Named owners, stop conditions, learner notice, data containment, recovery evidence, and restart approval for remote services.
controls.implementationImpact: Blocks real community, human queue, staff writes, and incentives until remote-service shutdown drills exist.
